decisions.reason: Single console TypeError at plugin A's unconditional useSessionPendingInteraction call; contract excerpts show the seat dropped and replaced by useSessionStatus on alpha.2 with useSessions retained; B's dock entry uses no standard-kit hooks and throws nothing.

Shared DrawerErrorBoundary over the whole input.dock list unmounts the entire subtree on A's render throw, matching the unmounted-entries log verbatim; attach button survives under input.left's separate boundary.

Frames disable-A as necessity/sufficiency/localization while stating it proves neither B's overall alpha.2 compatibility (paste path unexercised) nor that the strip crash is the only dock defect; reinstall of B shown structurally useless; colleague theory falsified by error count, experiment, and contract diff.

Dual-host usePendingBySession probes seats with typeof checks, reads pendingInteraction on alpha.2, returns a stable empty map when neither seat exists, keeps all main strip features, and justifies silent degradation because a throw unmounts co-tenants.

Client-half fix effective via rebuild plus hard refresh, no host restart; both dock entries must mount together; B regression covers paste/remove/re-paste with A enabled plus co-tenant-crash isolation; hygiene covers tenant destructuring/defensive probing, tenant-local boundaries, and host per-entry boundaries with trade-offs.

caps.reason: Final remedy targets plugin A; reinstalling B and two-independent-fixes are explicitly rejected as misdirected.
